# Minimal Test Problem

## Problem Background

A company needs to optimize its delivery routes. There are 5 delivery points with known distances between them.

## Problem Statement

1. Find the shortest route that visits all 5 points starting from point A.
2. Calculate the total distance of the optimal route.

## Data

Distance matrix (km):

| From | To: B | To: C | To: D | To: E |
|------|-------|-------|-------|-------|
| A    | 10    | 15    | 20    | 25    |
| B    | -     | 5     | 10    | 15    |
| C    | -     | -     | 5     | 10    |
| D    | -     | -     | -     | 5     |

## Requirements

- Provide mathematical formulation
- Solve using appropriate algorithm
- Present results in clear format
